attempts.summary: Configured node1's kernel to boot with audit=1 persistently, implemented via an Ansible playbook run from node2 (the only node with Ansible installed, used as control node). Discovered node1 is an Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image whose /etc/default/grub.d/50-cloudimg-settings.cfg overrides GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT after /etc/default/grub is sourced, so the playbook updates both files, runs update-grub, and reboots node1 to apply. Verified audit=1 is present in the live /proc/cmdline after reboot and persists. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol for both managed nodes (node1, node2), confirming changed boot IDs and post-restart recovery for each.
